identity.title: The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Red

leadText: The Best of Pokémon Adventures: Red is the first of two compilation volumes of the Pokémon Adventures released by VIZ Media. This volume contains a selection of chapters from the . As a result of this, many key events (including much of the Team Rocket storyline) are left out. This sometimes leads to references to events that are not included in this volume. The chapters come directly from VIZ Media's first edition translation of the series.
